test_description: Applicant completes and submits full online application
Save progress and resume via secure link within 30 days
Expired resume link (>30 days) shows expiry message
Existing customer details pre-filled after login
Invalid email/phone/postcode flagged inline before submit
Valid ID + selfie with match >=90% sets status Verified
Two failed face matches route to manual KYC review
Expired ID document blocks progression
Sanctions/PEP hit holds application and alerts Compliance
Bureau report retrieved only after consent captured
Income verified via open-banking connection
Score>=720 DTI<=35% amount<=25K auto-approved in <60s
Score 620-719 referred to underwriter queue with 24h SLA
Score<620 declined with adverse-action reasons
Rule threshold change requires checker approval before activation
Queue sorted by SLA; <4h highlighted red
Application locked while another underwriter is reviewing
Workbench shows application + docs + bureau + rule outcomes
Underwriter requests document; applicant notified and uploads
Email/SMS sent at submitted/referred/approved/declined
Portal displays current status and next step
Approved applicant e-signs; signed PDF stored and emailed
Unsigned offer withdrawn after 14 days
Signed loan posted to core banking disbursement API
Dashboard shows funnel/auto-decision rate/SLA breaches
Every decision logged with inputs/rules/user/timestamp; log immutable
